narration: Millions use one rule to plan their entire retirement — divide your spending by four percent. That's your number. But the guy who invented it now says it's broken.
visual: Calculator SVG displaying '$40K ÷ 4% = $1,000,000' springs in. Large '4% RULE' text fades in. Red banner labeled 'IS BROKEN' with crack lines appears. Sub-text 'you're $250K short' fades in below.

narration: Back in 1994, Bill Bengen crunched decades of market data to build this rule. Bonds were paying nearly seven percent back then — and it worked perfectly for that world.
visual: Calendar SVG showing 1994 springs in. Bond certificate card shows '6.8% annual yield' in green. Animated progress bar grows to represent the high bond yield era.

narration: Here's what broke it: bonds now pay half what they did then, and people live a full decade longer. That gives a four percent withdrawal roughly a one-in-three shot at running out before you do.
visual: Side-by-side boxes: '6.8% bonds 1994' in green vs '3.5% bonds today' in red, with downward arrow. Two lifespan bars: 1994 to age 80 (shorter), now to age 90+ (longer). Red warning box: '1 IN 3 CHANCE YOUR MONEY RUNS OUT'.

narration: New research says the safe rate now is three-point-three percent. On a million dollars that's only thirty-three grand a year. To safely pull forty thousand, you actually need one-point-two million.
visual: Two columns: left '$1M → $40K/year' with red X labeled RISKY, right '$1.21M → $40K/year' with green checkmark labeled SAFE (3.3%). Dark card below: 'MOST CALCULATORS STILL USE 4%'.

narration: That's a two-hundred-ten-thousand dollar gap between what your calculator shows and what you actually need. And almost every retirement app is still using the old number.
visual: Animated bar chart: red bar grows to $1M, green bar grows taller to $1.21M. Dashed gap line and '+$210K GAP' label appear at the top between the bars.

narration: The fix: target three-point-three percent. Add income streams so you pull less. Delay Social Security to 70 and you lock in a permanent thirty-two percent raise every month for life. Follow for more.
visual: Three action items spring in: 1) Target icon with '3.3%', 2) House and laptop icons with 'INCOME STREAMS', 3) Social security card icon 'DELAY TO 70'. Red CTA card: 'FOLLOW FOR MORE MONEY MOVES THEY HIDE FROM YOU'.
